13: function download (cb) {

20: /**
21:  * Downloads specified file with a url from the installer.
22:  *
23:  * @param installer            - An object with fileName, directory, url,
24:  *                                  and destination path of the file to be downloaded
25:  * @returns {Promise.<string>} - Promise resolving with the path to the downloaded file
26:  */
27: function downloadTools (installer) {
28:   return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
29:     const nuggetOptions = {
30:       target: installer.fileName,
31:       dir: installer.directory,
32:       resume: true,
33:       verbose: true,
34:       strictSSL: false
35:     }
36: 
37:     nugget(installer.url, nuggetOptions, (errors) => {
38:       if (errors) {
39:         // nugget returns an array of errors but we only need 1st because we only have 1 url
40:         const error = errors[0]
41: 
42:         if (error.message.indexOf('404') === -1) {
43:           return reject(error)
44:         } else {
45:           return reject(`Could not find ${installer.fileName} at ${installer.url}`)
46:         }
47:       }
48: 
49:       console.log(`Downloaded ${installer.fileName}. Saved to ${installer.path}.`)
50:       resolve(installer.path)
51:     })
52:   })
53: }
